description: For ecommerce operators responding to payment disputes and fraud losses.
offer_headline: Respond to chargebacks faster with an evidence-first workflow
cta_support_text: Join pilot to standardize dispute evidence and reduce preventable losses.
proof_points: Standardize dispute packets so each case is complete on first submission.
Prioritize by value and deadline to protect near-term cashflow.
Track win/loss reasons to continuously improve fraud controls.

faq.question: Does this connect directly to Stripe/Shopify?
faq.answer: The v1 workflow focuses on process orchestration first; integrations can be added after validation.

faq.question: Can this support multiple dispute reasons?
faq.answer: Yes. The rule engine can branch by reason code and required evidence set.

operational_checklist: Sort disputes by amount and response deadline.
Attach delivery, communication, and policy evidence in one bundle.
Review dispute outcomes weekly and update fraud prevention rules.
problem_statement: Chargeback disputes are handled ad hoc, causing avoidable revenue loss and missed response deadlines.

workflow.prompt_placeholder: e.g. We received 7 chargebacks this morning for delivered orders.

rules.first_step: Prioritize disputes by amount and deadline, then submit one complete proof bundle for the highest-value case today.
next_steps: Attach delivery confirmation, customer communication, and order metadata.
Use a consistent evidence template across all cases.
Track won/lost outcomes to refine fraud prevention rules.

rules.first_step: Generate a customer-communication timeline and pair it with proof-of-delivery before submitting the dispute.
next_steps: Bundle policy acceptance and tracking milestones.
Flag repeat offenders for future order review.

default_response.first_step: Create one evidence checklist and apply it to every open dispute this week.

business_tests.name: chargeback_burst_response
business_tests.input: We just got multiple chargebacks today and need a response process.
